summary: This appendix provides a comprehensive, numbered list of 112 Pāñcarātra texts, all of which are a type of scripture called a 'saṁhitā'. The list is explicitly stated to be sourced from another important text within the tradition, the Padma-saṁhitā. The appendix itself appears to be part of a larger work titled 'The Āgama Encyclopaedia'.
purpose: The purpose of this appendix is to serve as a bibliographic or canonical reference for scholars and practitioners of the Pāñcarātra tradition. It catalogs the names of numerous Saṁhitās as they are recognized and listed within the Padma-saṁhitā, providing a foundational list of texts central to this school of thought.
key_information: The appendix contains a list of 112 Pāñcarātra texts.
The source for this specific compilation of texts is the Padma-saṁhitā.
All listed texts are identified as a 'saṁhitā'.
The appendix is from a larger work, identified on the third page as 'The Āgama Encyclopaedia'.

Some text titles appear more than once in the list, such as Vāmana-samhitā (#68, #72, #110), and some duplicates are explicitly noted with a '(2)', like Āṅgīrasa-samhitā (#84) and Mārkaṇḍeya-samhitā (#100).

tables_and_data.description: A sequentially numbered list of Pāñcarātra texts (Saṁhitās) as found in the Padma-saṁhitā.
tables_and_data.data_summary: The data consists of a single list of 112 titles of Sanskrit texts. Each entry is a name ending with 'saṁhitā', such as 'Pādma-saṁhitā', 'Jayakhya-saṁhitā', and 'Ahirbudhnya-saṁhitā'. The list spans three pages and is presented in two columns per page.
